items.text: You were told by a member of the hall's booking committee, who is right about matters like this 3 times out of 4, that the hall's licence was raised to 300 people this year.

You checked the district licensing office's records yourself, which is right about matters like this 49 times out of 50. It shows that the Wren Hill hall is licensed for audiences of no more than 200 people.

story.question: Is the Wren Hill community hall licensed for an audience of 300?
